title: A "no-frills" tea maker for brewing different teas at various temperatures but it is not comparable to the Breville One-Touch
text:
A "no-frills" tea maker for brewing different teas at various temperatures but it is not comparable to the Breville One-Touch. I love everything tea and have purchased many brewing apparatuses. My favorite is the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville BTM800XL One-Touch Tea Maker]]. I love that tea maker so much that I purchased two of them at a cost of $500 because I cannot stand to be without a good tea brewer. (For those who are interested, I attached a link to my Breville review.)

This tea maker is a knock-off on that one. It is comparable in looks but in functionality it unfortunately falls a little short of my expectations.

PROS

- This tea maker is a very sleek looking unit.

- The infuser basket does not "leak" tea leaves due to the very fine mesh screening.

- The cord wraps into the base and has three slots from which to anchor it when unraveled. (NOTE: The cord is short at about 27 inches from exposed end to tip but that is typical of most appliances like this.)

- It is relatively easy to make tea or boil water with the push of a button as long as only the default steeping times are being used. There are buttons to boil water and for different type teas like white, green, black, etc.

- The unit comes with a tiny recipe pamphlet for different tea drinks.

CONS

- The white and green buttons should really be switched in my opinion. White tea is normally brewed at a lower temperature than green tea. Instead the green tea button brews at a lower temperature than white on this machine. I attached a link to a brewing chart in the comments section of this review.

- The process of steeping the tea is not as unattended as I would like because once the water heats up and the kettle beeps, it's time to add the tea basket. Then the basket must be removed after steeping has finished to avoid over steeping the tea.

- The basket is narrow and long which causes two issues. First, when using a tea that unfurls (like Pomegranate Oolong from Harney and Sons or Jasmine pearls), the leaves tend to expand upward, leaving part of the leaves unsteeped which results in an uneven brew. Second, removing the leaves from the long infuser basket and cleaning it out is a bit more difficult than with a wider basket that is not so long.

- If I want to have the tea kept warm, I have to remember to set the keep warm function by pressing the tea button again after the brew is done but there's no way to tell that I've already set it. If I forget, the tea gets cold.

- Although it is possible to set custom steeping times, those times are not remembered once the unit is turned off. Also, the particular tea button originally chosen to heat the water has to be pressed once more to start the steeping process and then again and again for each minute increase in time. It is easy to lose count if distracted as there is no LED showing what was requested.

- This tea maker cannot be pre-programmed to start brewing at a certain time, meaning there is no Auto Start Option.

- The carafe lid is hard to dry due to the deep channel in the lid.

This is not a CON for me, but the carafe cannot be submerged in water. This is typical of any tea maker with a heating element attached. I just rinse the carafe or am very careful when washing its interior.

In summary, this tea maker is a "no-frills option" for those who want to brew different teas at various temperatures. It will suit that purpose just fine, especially if the tea is not left to sit in the water for an extended period of time. One can get use to its quirks and the fact that buttons have to be pressed multiple times without any indication of what's been done or any memory of the setting. I do not like that the white and green tea buttons are sort of atypical in the sense that green tea is usually brewed at a higher temperature than white; with this tea maker they have the temperatures reversed. Personally, my favorite is the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville BTM800XL One-Touch Tea Maker]] and nothing I have ever tried has even comes close to topping that unit. Nevertheless, this Mr. Coffee is acceptable.

features: 1.2 liter capacity with water level indicator up to 5 cups
Preset selections for steeping different types of tea: black, herbal, oolong, white, and green tea
Includes stainless steel kettle with premium quality SCHOTT DURAN glass
Stainless steel tea infuser is removable and dishwasher safe
description: Mr. Coffee's Hot Tea Maker and Kettle is a must-have for tea lovers who want to enjoy the ultimate at-home steeping experience using loose tea leaves or tea bags. Add fruits and other additions to create sumptuous, custom tea infusions—or use it to boil water for instant beverages and meals.
